name: Industrieele Groote Club, Dam 27
surveyedSource: Vertex average of the BAG 0363100012165129 ring (RD, PDOK BAG WFS, CC0) in native east/south metres above the 3DBAG ground 1.29 m NAP (scripts/landmarks/industrieele-groote-club-footprints.json, written by venue-prepare.ts). The pand holds the club building, the Dam 21 house, the Gassan arcade and the Kalverstraat backs: the Dam front's storeys are drawn from rectified Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0, venue-face-crops.ts at 40.5 px/m: TMX7316010203-002031_pano_0001_001692 and recording_2025-06-16_06-42-40_02285); roofs, the gable and tower tops and the backs keep the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0). Per wall in scripts/landmarks/industrieele-groote-club-inventory.json.

attribution.title: Koninklijke Industrieele Groote Club, Dam 27, Amsterdam: the club building of 1913-1916 with its tower and gable on the Dam
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the BAG footprint (CC0) with 3DBAG LoD2.2 heights and the 3DBAG shell for the roofs, gable and tower tops and backs (CC BY 4.0): the Dam front's stone ground floor with the carriage passage, shop arches, the club entrance under its carved name and crown, the stone frontispiece with tracery balustrade, the brick storeys of cross windows, gable-foot corbels and round window, the tower lights, the Dam 21 house with its oriel and the Gassan arcade. Measured from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.
